svg.title: otto axonometric component architecture
svg.desc: Parallel frontend crates depend on an expanded native runtime, with separate session, platform, SQLite and core support packages connected by selected dependency arrows.
svg.text: tool · sandbox · mcp · skill · memory · approval
Imports may skip lower layers. Upward imports are forbidden.
Separate packages; placement is not a layer order.
Solid arrows: selected crate dependencies. Dashed guides: internal layer alignment.
Shapes are conceptual components, not hardware.
Frontend-to-frontend imports and some direct lower-package imports are omitted. Dev-only crates: otto-faults / otto-eval.
